feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 24 July 2026 8:47am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 24 July 2026 at 8:45am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

There is a Strong Wind warning in operation for later tonight.


##Synopsis##

High pressure is centred to the northwest of the Azores, extending a ridge across the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

West or southwest force 3 or 4 occasionally 5, increasing 5 or 6 later tonight.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, becoming slight or moderate later tonight.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Mostly good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or southwest force 5 or 6, veering and decreasing west or northwest mainly 3 or 4 Saturday afternoon, but locally variable 3 or less around the Isle of Man. Then becoming west or southwest 3 or 4 in all waters later Saturday evening, before increasing west or northwest 5 or 6 overnight into Sunday.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming mainly slight Saturday afternoon, then building slight or moderate again overnight into Sunday.


##Weather##

Occasional light rain and drizzle.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate at times in rain or drizzle.
